_about: Budgets for scripts/token_budget.py, in local-estimate tokens. 'max' gates --check; 'target' is advisory and only reported. null means no limit. Override a max with --budget ID=N. Raise a max deliberately, in this file, when new text earns its place.

metadata.why: Agent Skills overview: Level 1 metadata costs about 100 tokens per skill and sits in context on every turn while the skill is enabled.

activation.why: max: regression ceiling just above the current size, so growth is a deliberate decision. History: 5500 (Phase 4B), 5600 (Phase 4C), 5900 (communication-quality recovery), 6200 (communication-experience upgrade), 6150 (communication priority correction), 5750 (communication simplification). Raised to 6350 for the owner's house style (docs/COMMUNICATION_SIMPLIFICATION_AUDIT.md §8): the always-on paragraph, bullet, emoji-point, spacing and plain-language rules plus the emoji working set cost about 530 tokens that the simplification's 390-token saving did not cover. The full palette is in references/emoji-palette.md and costs nothing until read. target: the Agent Skills overview puts Level 2 instructions under 5k tokens, and Claude Code re-attaches only the first 5,000 tokens of an invoked skill after auto-compaction. The house style sits in the first 5,000 tokens on purpose; op:close and Step 3 fall outside it.

ref:explanation-examples.md.why: On demand. The overview states bundled files cost nothing until read.

persistent:project-instructions.why: Opt-in standing guidance, paid on every turn of every chat in the Project.
